command: START=$(cat /tmp/lcl_scan_start); END=$(cat /tmp/lcl_scan_end); WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); START="$START" END="$END" WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{const xs=[...document.querySelectorAll("input")];if(xs.length<2)throw new Error("scan inputs missing");for(const [e,v] of [[xs[0],${JSON.stringify(process.env.START)}],[xs[1],${JSON.stringify(process.env.END)}]]){const s=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,"value").set;s.call(e,v);e.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true}));e.dispatchEvent(new Event("change",{bubbles:true}));}return xs.map(x=>x.value).join(" -> " )})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){if(m.result.exceptionDetails){console.error(JSON.stringify(m.result.exceptionDetails));process.exit(1)}console.log("RANGE_INPUTS="+m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}' && sleep 1
